applies_to: scoring comparisons between a prediction value and a Gold value on the development set
rule: An alias group makes two spellings of the same identity compare equal. It never rewrites a prediction, never edits a Gold value, and never changes what a model is asked to output.

alias_groups.note: Gold stores reported_value CF3CH2OH beside canonical_value TFE; exact-string equality between the two forms is not required.

open_question: Other solvent, ligand, catalyst, substrate and product identities still compare by exact normalized string. A comparator policy for those is deliberately deferred until the Gold distribution is known.
